gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (printed p18) Transfers in (out): General (695,902), Street 695,902, Sales Tax (714,797), CDA (72,594); transfers_in 695,902 = Street. Detail uses the General Fund departmental combining statement (pp17-18), which prints 'Transfers from (to) other funds' per department: Administrative (2,093,381) and Police 645,134 + Summer Recreation 157,995 + Park 84,108 + Pool 87,166 + Auditorium 136,566 + Library 158,820 + Zoning 127,112 + Recycling 578 = 1,397,479 in (detail indexes 106-113). These 1,397,479 are transfers between General Fund departments (net General Fund (695,902) = (2,093,381) + 1,397,479). Detail transfers in 1,397,479 + Street 695,902 = 2,093,381; gap -1,397,479 is the intra-General-Fund departmental transfers printed gross on the departmental schedule. Printed as such; no fix.

Same cause as transfers_in: detail out = Administrative (2,093,381) p17 + Sales Tax (714,797) p12 + CDA (72,594) p13 = 2,880,772 vs statement 1,483,293 (695,902 + 714,797 + 72,594, p5). The 1,397,479 difference is the General Fund departments' transfers among themselves printed gross on the departmental combining statement (pp17-18); it nets to the printed General Fund (695,902). No fix.

Proprietary funds statement p7 (printed p21) has Electric, Water and Sewer Fund columns and no proprietary schedule, so detail has no business-type lines. JSON receipts = operating revenues + interest income + grant income + gain (loss) on sale of assets (12,475,983). Per column: Electric 4,145,683 + 13,206 + 228,071 + (6,161) = 4,380,799; Water 1,002,290 + 10,275 + 52,693 + 4,014,216 = 5,079,474; Sewer 515,634 + 512 + 67,002 + 2,332,562 + 100,000 = 3,015,710; total 12,475,983 = statement. 0 + 12,475,983 = 12,475,983, gap 0.
